verses.text: Praise the LORD! You who serve the LORD, praise his name!
Bless the LORD’s name now and forever.
From sunrise to sunset, let the LORD’s name be praised!
The LORD stands high above every nation. His glory is higher than the heavens.
Who’s like the LORD our God, sitting on his throne way up high,
yet bending down to look at heaven and earth?
He raises the poor out of the dust and lifts the needy off the ash heap.
He gives them a seat with princes, right alongside the princes of his people.
He gives the woman who couldn’t have children a home where she’s a joyful mother. Praise the LORD!
